title: Stop Athena- trailers after cutover C0; fix test and reader coverage
summary: Retry of job 20261025-012657-hac3 (D111 job 7 part 1b): after cutover C0, commits from Committer::build_commit_in, commit_with_staged and squash_text carry no Athena- trailers, while trailer readers (status/trace, auditor) keep reading trailers up to C0. Audience: the verifier and maintainers. This retry fixes the two failures: the end-to-end test must assert check_history and check_attribution PASS with no violations, and each fallback reader and the commits.rs strip need their own test.

defaults_applied.how: Each reader and writer gets a covering test; clippy, fmt, test clean.
Criteria assert check_history/attribution pass and readers behave on both sides of C0.
Behavior criteria name cargo commands the verifier can run.
All trailer readers/writers covered, not only the one that surfaced.
Docs and changelog written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The retry starts from the base; the earlier design (relaxed squash_text, post-C0 fallback readers) is re-implemented with the two test gaps fixed.
The cutover job 20261025-001232-vesh is already landed in the repository.
The change description should list every trailer reader and writer with its covering test.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: a scratch-repository test lands the cutover job (C0), then builds ONE job branch with an intervention commit (commit_with_staged), a records-only commit (Committer) and the job's landing commit, and lands it via land_pr with a squash merge. It asserts the squash commit and each of the three PR commits (via the landing record's second parent) have no 'Athena-' line.

Run cargo test: in that scratch repository the landing record classifies the commits as declared_intervention, records_only and job_landing, and the test asserts check_history and check_attribution return NO violations (empty violations, not an expectation of violations) on the post-C0 base; legacy-exempt records are set up as needed.
Run cargo test: squash_text has a strict form and a relaxed post-C0 form, each tested; the relaxed form emits no Athena- line and is used for post-C0 landings.
Run cargo test: a test in commits.rs covers the after-C0 strip (cutover landed: no trailers) and the kept-trailer cases (no cutover_job, or no landing record yet: trailers still written).

Run cargo test: a test in status.rs (athena trace) and a separate test in auditor.rs each cover both sides of C0: trailers read for commits up to and including C0, C0..head fallback after it, same results as before for pre-C0 history.
Run cargo test: after C0 check_history runs only secrets and attribution, and the gate's own check keeps content and jobs checks but drops trailer-dependent invariant::check; tested.

CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md describe the end of trailer writing after C0 (D111, job 7 part 1b), name which readers still use trailers up to C0, and state accurately that after C0 the history check runs only secrets and attribution.
Run cargo clippy --all-targets, cargo fmt --check and cargo test: all clean; no governance files (athena.toml, ci.yml) change; pre-C0 behavior unchanged.

out_of_scope: Pre-handover harness checks proposed in the introspection
departures: Large multi-crate change that already failed once; somewhat higher cost and lower pass chance than reference.
